title: Open when you miss me

title: Open when life feels heavy

Toh itne saare log jiske saath h, uska tension kuch nhi bigaad payega. VAISE BADE BADE SEHRON ME CHHOTI CHHOTI BAATEIN HOTI REHTI HAIN SENORITA😂.
